text:
sophie: PRD intake — per-customer quality thresholds + automated rollback. Problem: some customers require strict quality guarantees; when model outputs fall below customer-specific thresholds we should automatically route to a vetted fallback and, if in a rollout, rollback the variant. Need: requirements, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and success metrics.

omar: quick clarifying q — is scope: (A) per-route thresholds (e.g., chat vs summarization) or (B) per-customer global? or both?

kevin: my preference is per-customer per-route. customers have different UX for chat vs batch emb. we can store thresholds keyed by (customer_id, route).

anya: prodops constraints: any automatic routing/rollback must preserve latency SLOs. if fallback adds >200ms p50 we need opt-out or async fallback. also we need audit logs + who gets alerted.

elena: acceptance criteria draft: 1) Config API to create/update thresholds per (customer, route). 2) Runtime enforces check in request path with <1% added latency. 3) When threshold breached, action = one of {route_to_variant, disable_variant, flag_for_manual-review}. 4) Rollback executes if variant error-rate or quality metric exceeds threshold for N windows. 5) All actions are logged and visible in Console.

kevin: metrics we can use: semantic-similarity (embedding cosine), rerank score, token-perplexity proxy, and sample-based human-label rates. need to define default metric per route.

sophie: non-goals: this does NOT include full offline model-retraining pipeline or automated label collection. also not building per-customer custom models. focus is runtime gating + rollback only.

omar: edge cases to call out: - noisy short inputs (similarity unstable) - cold starts for new customers (lack of baseline) - customers with adversarial prompts causing metric spikes

kevin: proposal for cold-start: use org-level defaults for first 1k requests, then allow override after N samples.

elena: suggested acceptance test (can be automated): 1) Create threshold for customer C1 route /chat with sim_threshold=0.80. 2) Send 200 requests with simulated drift -> metric > threshold for 3 consecutive windows. 3) Verify traffic routed to fallback within 30s, rollback flag set on variant, alert fired to oncall, and Console shows timeline.

anya: operational checklist: - alert receiver list (oncall, solutions-eng, customer-ops) - RBAC for who can change thresholds - rate limit config to avoid noisy flips - canary rollout test before enabling automatic rollback for new customers

sophie: success metrics (for first 90 days): - reduction in customer-reported quality incidents by 40% for covered customers - median time-to-detect quality regressions <= 5m - rollback false-positive rate < 2% - no violation of latency SLOs for 99th pct of requests

kevin: quick config example:```
quality_thresholds:
  customer_id: C123
  route: /chat
  metric: semantic_similarity
  window_size: 100
  threshold: 0.82
  breach_windows: 3
  action:
    type: route_to
    target: model-legacy-v2
    rollback: true
    notify: ["@sophie","@oncall"]
```

omar: who owns the API + Console work? i can take the API surface (couple days spec), elena can own runtime gating changes, anya will own ops runbook. sophie you own rollout/pm.

sophie: yup I'll drive rollout plan and customer opt-ins. next steps: i'll write a short RFC with these bullets + acceptance tests. pls add any missing edge cases here. :eyes: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch perf/fallback-gating (staging) — build #4521

anya: quick note — add a kill-switch per-customer in Console in case of misfires.

sophie: added to RFC todo. thanks all!
